data.one_liner: A single-purpose Flutter widget to create linear and radial gradient texts easily.
data.what_it_does: Provides a GradientText widget that applies linear or radial color gradients directly to text. It supports properties like style, colors, gradient stops, max lines, soft wrap, and text scaling.
use_when: You need to display text with a linear or radial color gradient in your Flutter app.
You want a simple widget-based alternative to manually setting up ShaderMask for gradient texts.
avoid_when: You require complex multi-color animations or shaders that go beyond standard linear and radial gradients.
strengths: Very easy to set up and use with a clean widget API.
Supports both linear and radial gradients out of the box.
Includes support for gradient stops, max lines, and text scaling.
weaknesses: Limited to linear and radial text gradients.
Does not handle complex text animations natively.
data.minimal_example:
GradientText(
    'Gradient Text Example',
    style: TextStyle(
        fontSize: 40.0,
    ),
    colors: [
        Colors.blue,
        Colors.red,
        Colors.teal,
    ],
)
